newsitem.title: THAILAND: Two Thai bank stocks limit down on selling.
newsitem.headline: Two Thai bank stocks limit down on selling.

text.p: Two Thai banks reached their limit low on Monday shortly after the battered stock market reopened after the lunch break, brokers said.
Bank of Asia fell 4.25 baht to 40.50 and Siam City Bank dropped 3.50 to 31.50.
Foreign investors were behind heavy sales of banking and finance stocks on a variety of negative factors that were seen affecting the profitability of banks in general, brokers said.

Among the negative factors were measures announced by the Bank of Thailand on Friday which put limits on short-term loans that offshore banking units bring into Thailand for re-lending, dim prospects for interest rate cuts by year-end and heavy sales by foreign firms on the market, brokers said.
Major banks like Bangkok Bank Plc and Thai Farmers Bank were also driven down by sales, they added.
